title: Define the reader
text: We agree on the audience, purpose, tone, length and deadline before writing begins.

title: Research and shape
text: I gather the necessary material, identify the central argument and build a clean structure.

title: Draft and revise
text: You receive a complete draft, followed by an agreed revision round focused on useful feedback.

title: Deliver clean copy
text: The final version is proofread and supplied in a practical format ready to publish or hand off.
